summary: Iteration 5 final verification. Full backend regression: 114/114 pytest passed (cleanup before + after). Added /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_fixes.py (6 new tests, all pass) covering counter/member_code, catalogue rows and report projections. All 5 targeted fixes verified end-to-end via UI: (1) member_code collision fixed — sequential unique codes (IPF-1030/31/32 via API, IPF-1033 via UI), unique compound index (organisation_id, member_code) present, counters collection initialised (member seq, receipt seq) and monotonic; (2) Plans PT/Service/Product tabs each render 1 catalogue row (PT price/sessions render correctly); (3) /app/reports Outstanding Dues (6 rows) and Membership Expiry (15 rows) render with zero console errors — no duplicate-key warnings, all API rows carry unique id; (4) MemberDrawer Record Payment (Rs.500) and Renew with amount>0 (Rs.700) both open the receipt modal with correct amount; (5) Freeze modal prefills Freeze Until = 03 Oct 2026 (today+30). Smoke pass: landing page violet theme renders, demo login, dashboard KPIs (26 members / 22 active / 12 attendance / Rs.6,000 collection), members drawer action sheet, announcements page + create modal, super admin console (3 gyms, KPIs, Gyms/Platform Settings/Audit Logs tabs). All test-created data purged; demo gym restored to exactly 26 members.

critical_code_review_comments: Member codes are now allocated purely from db.counters, so codes are monotonic but not gapless — after test runs the demo gym's next code is IPF-1033 rather than IPF-1027. This is correct/expected (no collision) but worth noting the review's expected 'IPF-1027' will not match after any prior member creation.
GET /api/members/{id} returns a nested shape {member, payments, attendance} — documented here for future test authors (earlier assumption of a flat member object failed).
